title: سریالی – کاگویا ساما عشق یعنی جنگ – گذر به بزرگسالی
titleEn: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War - Stairway to Adulthood
description: Kaguya sat alone in her room, looking through an album. Inside were photos capturing memories spent with Shirogane and her friends at Shuchiin Academy. As she turned the pages, lost in nostalgia, Kaguya's memories came flooding back.
